name: selfblog
help: Blog system for selfdoc-based documentation sites

check.name: check
check.help: Check blog posts and unified multi-project documentation. For unified docs-site projects, runs the full documentation check across every constituent project plus the docs-site's own content; otherwise validates blog posts (POST001-POST005).

flags.name: ignore
flags.help: Comma-separated lint codes to suppress (e.g., SEO007,SEO008)

flags.name: auto-commit
flags.help: Automatically commit updated content hash tracking files to git after checking

build.name: build
build.help: Build blog posts or unified documentation site

flags.name: target
flags.help: Build target: 'posts' for posts-only build, 'unified' for unified multi-project site

flags.name: drafts
flags.help: Include posts marked as draft in the build output

flags.name: auto-commit
flags.help: Automatically commit updated content hash tracking files to git after the build

post.name: post
post.help: Manage blog posts and chronological content for the documentation site

new.name: new
new.help: Scaffold a new blog post markdown file with a date-prefixed filename and frontmatter template containing title, date, slug, tags, draft status, and project metadata. Creates the file in the configured posts directory and exits with an error if the file already exists.

flags.name: title
flags.help: Title for the new blog post, used in frontmatter and filename generation

list.name: list
list.help: List all discovered blog posts with date, title, slug, and draft status. Scans the configured posts directory for markdown files with frontmatter, parses their metadata, and prints a formatted summary showing each post's publication date, title, slug identifier, and whether it is marked as a draft.

generate.name: generate
generate.help: Generate a blog post markdown file from structured release metadata. Takes version, bump type, description, changelog, and registry URLs as inputs, produces a frontmatter-bearing post with title, date, tags, and body content, and updates the project manifest with the new post entry.

flags.name: from-release
flags.help: Generate the post from structured release metadata rather than freeform content

flags.name: version
flags.help: The released version number to feature in the generated blog post title and metadata

flags.name: prev-version
flags.help: Previous version number, used to show what version this release upgrades from

flags.name: bump-type
flags.help: Semver bump type (patch, minor, or major) included in the post frontmatter

flags.name: description
flags.help: Short release description text included as the post summary paragraph

flags.name: context
flags.help: Additional context explaining the rationale for this release, included in generated blog posts

flags.name: changelog-file
flags.help: Path to a markdown file whose contents are embedded as the changelog section of the post

flags.name: body-file
flags.help: Path to a file containing user-written prose to include as the main post body content

flags.name: project-name
flags.help: Human-readable project name used in the blog post title and frontmatter metadata

flags.name: release-url
flags.help: Full URL to the GitHub release page, linked from the generated blog post

flags.name: registry-url
flags.help: Package registry URL such as PyPI or npm page, can be specified multiple times

publish.name: publish
publish.help: Publish non-draft blog posts to the documentation assembly. Builds posts locally, pushes built HTML and manifest to the assembly repo via the Git Data API, then dispatches a shared-only workflow to regenerate cross-project elements.

grants.name: assembly-dispatch
grants.reason: triggers a GitHub Actions workflow on the assembly repository, which rebuilds and republishes the live documentation site

assembly.name: assembly
assembly.help: Manage the unified multi-project documentation assembly and deployment

init.name: init
init.help: Create and initialize the assembly GitHub repository with workflow and configuration files. Creates a private GitHub repo, pushes initial files via the Contents API, creates a Cloudflare Pages project if credentials are available, and sets GitHub secrets for deployment authentication.

grants.name: create-repo
grants.reason: creates a new private GitHub repository under the configured owner; repository creation is not undone by rerunning the command

grants.name: create-pages-project
grants.reason: creates a Cloudflare Pages project on the configured account, claiming its *.pages.dev subdomain

grants.name: set-secret
grants.reason: writes Cloudflare deployment credentials into the assembly repository's GitHub Actions secrets

push.name: push
push.help: Dispatch a GitHub Actions workflow to rebuild this project in the documentation assembly. Detects the source repository, resolves the latest git tag as the version reference, and sends a repository dispatch event to the assembly repo with the project slug, version, and commit SHA.

grants.name: assembly-dispatch
grants.reason: triggers a GitHub Actions workflow on the assembly repository, which rebuilds and republishes the live documentation site

status.name: status
status.help: Show the status of recent assembly build workflow runs on GitHub. Queries the assembly repository for recent workflow runs using the GitHub CLI and displays their status, conclusion, and timing information for monitoring deployment progress.

rebuild.name: rebuild
rebuild.help: Dispatch rebuild workflows for every project registered in the assembly. Fetches the projects.json manifest from the assembly repository, then sends a separate GitHub Actions repository dispatch event for each registered project to trigger a full documentation rebuild.

grants.name: assembly-dispatch
grants.reason: triggers a GitHub Actions workflow on the assembly repository, which rebuilds and republishes the live documentation site

redirects.name: redirects
redirects.help: Generate a Cloudflare Pages _redirects file for this project that redirects standalone documentation URLs to the corresponding paths on the unified assembly site. Requires a project slug and assembly base URL as inputs, prints the redirect rules to stdout.

flags.name: slug
flags.help: Project slug used as the URL path segment in the assembly site structure

flags.name: docs-base
flags.help: Base URL of the assembly documentation site used for generating redirect targets

generate-shared.name: generate-shared
generate-shared.help: Generate 6 shared cross-project elements for the assembled documentation site. Reads per-project manifest JSON files, merges post overlays, and produces a homepage, blog index, navigation JSON, RSS feed, XML sitemap, and security headers file in the site output directory.

flags.name: site-dir
flags.help: Path to the combined site output directory where shared HTML files are written

flags.name: manifests-dir
flags.help: Path to the directory containing per-project manifest JSON files for the assembly

flags.name: docs-base
flags.help: Base URL of the assembled documentation site (e.g. 'https://docs.smmh.dev'). Used for generating absolute URLs in feeds, sitemaps, and page links. Defaults to empty string for root-relative URLs.

flags.name: canonical-base
flags.help: Absolute canonical base URL of the assembly site, from topology.docs_base (e.g. 'https://docs.smmh.dev'). Required: it is the target of the generated redirect worker and of the rel=canonical links on the homepage and blog index, so it cannot be root-relative like --docs-base.

flags.name: legacy-blog-host
flags.help: Hostname of a retired blog subdomain (e.g. 'blog.smmh.dev') to 301 onto the canonical blog URL. Empty when no such subdomain exists.

flags.name: portfolio-file
flags.help: Path to a portfolio HTML file to use as the site root index.html. When provided and the file exists, the project listing moves to /projects/index.html.
